handbookNote: Colorado Revised Statutes Title 24, Article 21, Part 5 -- the Revised Uniform Law on Notarial Acts (RULONA), C.R.S. 24-21-501 to 24-21-540, including Colorado's remote/electronic notarization provisions at 24-21-514.5 and 24-21-520 -- batch 2 is a depth-expansion pass over the same statute covered by the original 62-question co_notary track: it drills into definitional terms, sub-clauses, and enumerated lists left untested in batch 1, adds scenario/fact-pattern variations of already-tested rules (disqualifying interest, identification standards, remote-notarization eligibility, discipline grounds, prohibited acts), and covers several sections batch 1 did not touch at all (24-21-510, 24-21-513, 24-21-528, 24-21-532, 24-21-533, 24-21-536 through 24-21-539). Price matches this project's established Notary tier ($9.99), unchanged from batch 1.
